run.name: Novelis Inc.
run.sector: Rolling Drawing & Extruding of  Nonferrous Metals
run.title: CP-OS host session
run.summary: Novelis is a large, diversified credit whose leverage rose to 4.7x against a 3.5x target and whose liquidity fell to 2,038, while covenants hold and no sizeable bond matures before April 2029. Deleveraging depends on Bay Minette and cash recoveries. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA before adjustments (company reconciliation), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Calculated at March 31, 2026: debt principal 7,978 and Adjusted Net Debt 6,724 over fiscal 2026 Adjusted EBITDA 1,645. Company prints net 4.1. Management EBITDA.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Calculated: Adjusted EBITDA 1,645 over interest paid 242 (AR page:112). Management EBITDA over cash interest paid.

cash.basis: Cash. September 30, 2026 (Q2R page:61). Revolver availability was 606, with 128 of the revolver utilized for letters of credit and 147 of the availability usable for letters of credit (Q2R page:19). Uncommitted Citi and MUFG facilities are excluded because they are not committed.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No executed debt agreements, ratings or interim cash interest were supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure.
CP-1 main limitation: Cash interest is printed only annually; interim cover ratios and the September 2025 balance sheet are not supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure.
